title: FMU
text: Include Functional Mockup Unit (FMU) in model, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Filter logs by return status} sets Filter debug logs OK; {FMU name}, {Enable FMU tolerance}, {Relative tolerance} sets the fMU relative tolerance 1E-3, {Simulate FMU using} selects binary for simulation, {Enable event mode} sets the fMU in event mode, {Communication Step Size} sets the step size between co-simulation time, {Enable FMU debug logging} enables FMU logging display for debug, {Redirect debug logs to} sets the direct streaming debug and {Call FMU functions using} sets the source of FMI API for the generated code. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Placeholder port none | | string size limited to 255

params.name: Simulate FMU using
params.values: Select binary for simulation x86_64-windows (default) | x86-windows | x86_64-linux

params.name: Enable event mode
params.values: FMU in event mode on (default) | off

params.name: Communication Step Size
params.values: Step size between co-simulation time instants -1 (default) | scalar positive

params.name: Enable FMU debug logging
params.values: Enable FMU logging display for debug purposes off (default) | on

params.name: Filter logs by return status
params.values: Filter debug logs OK | Warning | Discard | Error | Fatal | Pending

params.name: Redirect debug logs to
params.values: Direct streaming debug logs File (default) | Display

params.name: Call FMU functions using
params.values: Specify source of FMI API for the generated code auto | source code | shared library
